name: Today task
query:
SELECT
    t.name                                                 AS "Task ID:Link/Task:140",
    t.subject                                              AS "Subject::300",
    COALESCE(p.project_name, t.project)                    AS "Project::220",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(u.full_name, td.allocated_to)
                 SEPARATOR ', ')                           AS "Assigned To::250",
    COALESCE(o.full_name, t.owner)                         AS "Owner::200",
    COALESCE(c.full_name, t.completed_by)                  AS "Completed By::200",
    t.completed_on                                         AS "Completed On:Datetime:160",
    t.status                                               AS "Status::120",
    t.priority                                             AS "Priority::100",
    t.exp_start_date                                       AS "Expected Start:Date:130",
    t.exp_end_date                                         AS "Expected End:Date:130"
FROM `tabTask` t
LEFT JOIN `tabProject` p
       ON p.name = t.project
LEFT JOIN `tabToDo` td
       ON td.reference_type = 'Task'
      AND td.reference_name = t.name
      AND IFNULL(td.status,'') != 'Cancelled'
LEFT JOIN `tabUser` u
       ON u.name = td.allocated_to
LEFT JOIN `tabUser` o
       ON o.name = t.owner
LEFT JOIN `tabUser` c
       ON c.name = t.completed_by
WHERE
      (
        (t.exp_start_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.exp_start_date) = CURDATE())
        OR
        (t.exp_end_date   IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.exp_end_date)   = CURDATE())
      )
GROUP BY t.name
ORDER BY
    COALESCE(t.exp_start_date, t.exp_end_date) ASC,
    t.exp_end_date ASC;
